_doc: Units check-cg and check-ngd each measure alone under CCV_HEAVY_SERIAL, on by default in every gate (DA, 2026-11-01 for CI, 2026-11-02 for local gates; CCV_HEAVY_SERIAL=0 turns it off): a heavy unit holds the lock exclusive, every other unit shared, so nothing runs beside it. Kept after the ROB split (OA-24) as future-proofing (DA, 2026-11-02); the full-size ooe_rob it was built for (Yosys and ABC 10.7 GB together) is gone. light_rss_max_mib: with the lock on, a unit not named here whose one command peaks over this fails the check; each command's own peak, measured through tools/rss-run.py (eda9ce8). 2048 MiB: four light units at once stay well within a 16 GB runner. ooe_rob_w stays listed to be safe (DA, 2026-11-03). Readings depend on ccache (TI #70, 2026-11-07): a local gate keeps a warm ccache, CI starts every runner with an empty one, so a unit whose largest command is a C++ compile reads far lower locally. Judge a unit by a CI or release-run reading, or a local one under CCACHE_DISABLE=1.

units.ooe_rob_w: one warp's ooe_rob_w (OA-24, the ROB split; the full-size ooe_rob it replaced peaked at 7514 MiB). Its own peak at 5e5280f (2026-11-03, the first gate with the split and eda9ce8's own-peak measurement): 1202 MiB in check-cg, 1918 MiB in check-ngd, 6% under the light limit; kept listed since the ROB grows with OI's slices. ooe_rename (1014 / 650 MiB) and ooe_sched (975 / 975 MiB) left the list at the same gate; both had been listed from readings that counted check-cg's own size or an older bench
units.ooe_sched: ooe_sched's check-cg peaks in the netlist replay harness's cold C++ compile: one cc1plus -Os on Vcg_tb___024root__8.cpp (5.5 MB) at 2394 MiB (local, CCACHE_DISABLE=1, cc1e294, 342 flops); release run 795 read 2395 MiB, CI runs 611-634 2190 MiB at 294 flops. A local gate reads Yosys's 975 MiB because its ccache already holds the harness. Its bench build peaks at 426 MiB cold. Listed so it never runs beside another unit on a 16 GB runner (TI, 2026-11-04; cause found 2026-11-07, TI #70).
units.ooe_decq: ooe_decq's unit peaks at 2847 MiB in check-cg with CCV_P_DECQ 15 and the free lag's staging register (OI-111, OI's gate on d32f65e, 2026-11-04); listed so it never runs beside another unit (TI, 2026-11-04).
units.ooe_rs: RA-39 (c)'s payload store and issue register at PW 176 (45 entries, a 30:1 read into 9 slots): its check-ngd peaks at 3056 MiB, its check-cg at 1985 MiB (OI's gate on 6ed8b04, 2026-11-05); listed so it never runs beside another unit (TI's OK, TI rev 327).
units.rcu_bank_slice: RI's 205k-cell rcu_bank_slice at FULL_ROW 1, 192 rows: check-cg's own Python holds ~800 MiB for its netlist (the unit's peak with children, cold, ~1450 MiB). Four such units (rcu_bank_slice, _k0, _k2, _k3, added together by RI's 70cfd51) measured side by side in check-cg's threads, beside check-ngd, took check-cg to 4.8 GB and the 15 GB container's OOM killer ended the full gate on fc42fabd (2026-11-08); listed so each runs alone (TI #91).
